caveats: Family labels are curator assertions; cross-check against each target's rcsb_title.
Sample size is tiny — within/across separation is descriptive, not a statistical claim.
Cosine similarity in ESM-2 space sits in a narrow band; it is not a probability.
No baseline (random vectors, k-mer, BLOSUM) and no structural metric (TM-score) compared here.
